payload.prompt:
Review web/js/*.js and web/index.html, web/dag.html, web/styles/console.css, web/vercel.json, web/config.example.js against web/SPEC.md and supabase/schema.sql.

Context: Phase A step 2 of a read-only Supabase-backed mirror of the Flask-based Teacher Console at console.py. Two sonnet subagents produced the JS files independently; I wrote scaffolding + CSS. All files are in web/. CSS was aligned to the JS class names post-hoc.

Please return a concise punch list (under 400 words) of:

1. Bugs or contract violations against SPEC.md (DOM IDs, api.js signatures).
2. XSS / security holes (unsafe innerHTML, unescaped user content, anon key assumptions).
3. CSS/JS class mismatches — any class referenced in JS but missing in CSS, or vice versa (I already fixed the artifact-sq and tag-* families, but double-check).
4. Any api.js query that will fail against the schema defined in supabase/schema.sql.
5. Dead code / over-abstraction / CLAUDE.md violations (no new-feature comments, no tests for impossible branches, no framework bloat).
6. One thing that is clearly broken vs what a user would see.

Do not propose tests. Do not rewrite files. Punch-list only; I'll apply fixes. Include file:line references where possible.
